## 🚀 Rapid Deployment & Implementation

*From Zero to Production in Weeks - Not Months*

- Deploy fully validated Teal dashboards for Phase I-IV clinical trials with industry-standard modules
- Implement out-of-the-box safety tables (AE summaries, lab trends, exposure analysis) compliant with ICH-E3 guidelines
- Configure efficacy endpoints modules (time-to-event, binary outcomes, longitudinal analyses) for regulatory submissions
- Integrate CDISC-compliant datasets (SDTM, ADaM) with automated validation and quality checks
- Adapt Teal framework to non-standard data sources: real-world evidence, patient registries, observational studies
- Deliver GxP-validated environments with complete Installation/Operational Qualification documentation
:::

::: {.band .band-alt}
## 🎨 Custom Module Development & Unique Visualizations

*Bring Your Vision to Life - Bespoke Clinical Visualizations*

- Design custom patient journey timelines showing treatment progression, dose modifications, and clinical events
- Build advanced waterfall plots with RECIST criteria, biomarker overlays, and response annotations
- Create interactive swimmer plots displaying multi-therapy timelines, adverse events, and disease milestones
- Develop proprietary in-house modules tailored to your therapeutic area (oncology, cardiology, rare diseases)
- Package reusable module libraries for standardized company-wide reporting frameworks
- Implement branded dashboards matching corporate design guidelines and color schemes
- Deliver fully documented and validated custom modules ready for regulatory inspection

::: {.band}
## ⚡ Interactive Drill-Down & JavaScript-Powered Analytics

*Click, Explore, Discover - Next-Generation Clinical Intelligence*

- Build multi-level drill-down systems: summary → cohort → individual patient with seamless navigation
- Embed JavaScript-powered visualizations using Plotly, D3.js, Highcharts for publication-quality graphics
- Implement clickable adverse event hierarchies: SOC → HLGT → PT with instant patient listings
- Create interactive patient profiles with synchronized timelines, lab values, and treatment history
- Deploy real-time filtering and brushing across linked visualizations for exploratory analysis
- Add custom tooltips and annotations with patient-level details accessible on hover/click
- Enable dynamic report generation capturing user interactions and filter states for reproducibility
:::
